name: Mask of the Comedian
body:
Price 40,020 gp; Slot head; CL 9th; Weight 1 lbs.; Aura moderate enchantment

DESCRIPTION

This crude wooden mask has a wide open mouth with a buffoonish grin. A creature wearing it speaks in a deep, booming voice that can’t be recognized as belonging to the wearer. The mask grants a +3 bonus on Perform (comedy) to the wearer. Three times per day, the wearer can tell a joke that has the effect of a symbol of laughter in a 60-ft. radius.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 20,010 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells glibness, symbol of laughter
